## #0 — A positive order of being
**Idealism names the dependence of determinate being upon the whole relation of appearing.** Subjective Immediacy is the knower; Objective Internality is the constituted means; World is the known; Life / Mind is their whole. Within that whole the order is **Subject / Consciousness → constituted means → determinate object**. The middle term names mind's mediating office, not Mind as the exhaustive name of reality.
The order is ontological. An object is a real determination of the whole, not an independently self-grounding item from which the whole relation can subsequently be assembled. [The argument of dependence](../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) carries the derivation; the concept keeps its terms and directions available for further use.
## #1 — What an additional object cannot supply
Appearing is present even in the act that doubts an appearance. A doubt changes an assertion within the field; its own occurrence remains. [Subject](C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) names the condition to which an object becomes available. A sensation, a brain, a model or an introspective report can each be made an object of further inquiry. More detail about one such object does not change its office into the condition of the entire relation.
The positive ontological step is that a thing's determinacy belongs to its being-disclosed: its identity, properties and differences arise within the articulated field. A causal account can explain a thing's production through other things. Idealism locates this real explanatory work within the relation its terms presuppose, rather than treating the account as a production of that relation from outside it. An account of the source is another determination; the source-condition is not exhausted by becoming a term in the account.
## #2 — The means makes a world inhabitable
[Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) gives the middle term its actual operations. Attention, memory, valuation, language and comparison participate in what can be known and done. [The conditions of worldhood](C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) include the relations through which something counts as a thing, an action or a reason. The means constitutes an inhabitable field rather than passing a ready-made world between already finished poles.
Objectivity includes resistance, persistence, measurement and shared consequence. A failed prediction returns an encountered difference to the means by which it was made. That correction is possible because a local account does not determine everything the whole can disclose. The private ego, with its wishes and self-image, is itself one formation in the field. World in mind does not mean World at the disposal of that ego.
A **paradigm** is a relatively durable organisation of these means. A **project** is a determinate form thrown forth through them. In [Genesis / Paradigm / Project / Epi-Logos](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md), a project can become a condition of a later act and can return an encounter that changes the enacted paradigm. Paradigm, Project and World therefore keep different offices even while their effects pass into one another.
## #3 — Prior in which respect?
A reflection can be encountered before its source is understood. It is then epistemically prior in that inquiry while remaining dependent on the source in being. The reflection can prompt an action, making it a cause of a later event. A proof can depend on premises in a logical order. An inquiry can identify a condition of possible experience in a transcendental order. These directions can cross without becoming the same dependency.
[The first-moving mirror](C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) gives a concrete test: a model leads a later encounter, yet its initiative does not make it the ontological author of its own conditions. [Focal and qualified predication](C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) keeps “prior” and “depends” attached to the respect in which they are asserted.
The inversion occurs when causal efficacy or epistemic precedence is exchanged for originating authority. A projection can become so influential that its source is permitted to appear only through the projection's categories. A paradigm can treat its finite horizon as self-grounding reality. The criticism concerns this change of office, not the real efficacy through which a project changes the world.
## #4 — The reference is real and source-dependent
A local Bimba can serve as the genuine reference for a bounded inquiry while remaining a pratibimba relative to wider sources. Its being revisable does not cancel its present source office. A returned observation may change the reference; later projections can then inherit that change. The sourceward movement makes the reference's authority more exact by revealing what it depends upon.
A technological relay gives this relation a worked instance. A forecast informs an intervention; the result becomes an input to a later forecast. The model can have caused a change while still depending on inherited measurements, material conditions and a commission. Correcting an observation, revising a model and changing the criterion of success are different returns. Their practical force depends on the correction reaching the condition that a later act actually inherits.
The idealist order locates this entire investigation within knower, means, known and whole. Making the means more articulate does not make it a complete inventory of the Subject. The condition to which the relay and its investigation appear retains its office as the account becomes more exact. This is a distinction of dependence, not a missing item that further inspection promises to supply.
## #5→0 — Dependence becomes a manner of acting
[Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) and [Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) return the order to consequential worlds among agencies. Relations contribute to their constitution: they are not merely connections attached after isolated units have become complete. Local agency persists through that participation and can change through encounters with others.
[Epi-Logos](../etymologies/genesis-paradigm-project-epilogos/WHOLE-FIELD.md#01--epi-logos--paradigmatic-reflexivity) makes a recognised dependency operative in the paradigm. A distinction can change how an answer is received, what a model is asked to do or which consequence its evaluator includes. The achieved account returns to its conditions without claiming a position outside the whole relation.
[Homologia / Analogia](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) carries this precision into comparison: participating terms retain the different ways in which they depend and correspond. The conclusion remains affirmative. The determination is real; its power to act is real; its relation to what it cannot exhaust is constitutive of that reality.
